meta.title: Costco catalog for the strict home-cooked plan (Central Florida)

fields.item: product name as Costco (or the alt store) lists it
fields.section: meat | seafood | produce | dairy | frozen | pantry | bakery (where it sits in the warehouse)
fields.kind: protein | carb | veg | fruit | fat | sauce | spice
fields.usableG: net grams per pack, computed in node from the labeled net weight (1 lb = 453.59237 g, 1 oz = 28.349523125 g); null for random-weight, count or volume items. This is the labeled net weight, not trimmed or cooked yield
fields.usableML: for liquids: mL per pack (1 fl oz = 29.5735 mL, 1 qt = 946.353 mL, 1 L = 1000 mL)
fields.approxG: random-weight items only: grams from an average weight shown on a Costco listing, so treat as approximate
fields.freezes: { ok: can/should you freeze it, how: method + time (FDA/FSIS where cited) }
fields.alt: where to buy if Costco lacks it
fields.use: which plan dishes it serves (for the menu builder)

confidenceScale.verified: Exact product name (and pack, where given) read from a Costco-owned page: a costco.com product page fetched for this file, or a sameday.costco.com listing title in the search index. This confirms Costco sells it in the US. It does NOT confirm today's stock at a Central Florida warehouse: Costco publishes no per-warehouse inventory, and costco.com 'out of stock' only means not shippable online.
confidenceScale.likely: A Costco-owned page shows the product, but the exact name, pack size or variant could not be pinned down, or the listing is old.
confidenceScale.unverified: Not found on a Costco page in this research (or not searched). Buy it at the alt store.

meta.stockCheck: In the Costco app, set your home warehouse and search the item name or number before the trip; meat-case and seafood items vary weekly.
meta.method: costco.com product pages fetched with curl (JSON-LD name/sku plus the spec table); sameday.costco.com pages need a session, so their titles and pack details come from the search index (marked 'via search index'). Publix pages via search index. No prices are used.
meta.sourcesFoodSafety: FDA Refrigerator & Freezer Storage Chart (Mar 2018), https://www.fda.gov/media/74435/download

products.item: Kirkland Signature USDA Prime Beef Loin Top Sirloin Steak Boneless Cap Off
products.pack: random-weight package, sold by the lb

freezes.how: Yes. Portion into single steaks, wrap tightly (or vacuum-seal), label the date, freeze within the fridge window (3-5 days raw). Best quality 6-12 months at 0°F (FDA chart: steaks). Thaw in the fridge 1-2 days.

products.alt: Any meat counter (e.g. Publix) for USDA Choice top sirloin
products.note: Costco's Kirkland Signature beef page lists Top Sirloin and calls it lean. A USDA Choice top sirloin is likely stocked as well, but no listing was found under that name. The listing's detail text also says 'USDA Choice', so check the grade on the label.

products.item: Kirkland Signature Fresh Wild Ahi Tuna
products.pack: random weight, sold by the lb

freezes.how: Yes, but buy fresh ahi the day you sear it. Raw fish keeps 1-2 days; lean fish best quality 6-8 months frozen (FDA chart).

products.alt: A fish counter (Publix, Whole Foods) or frozen ahi steaks; not verified here
products.note: Answer to 'fresh or frozen?': Costco lists FRESH Kirkland Signature wild ahi in some warehouses' same-day catalogs; whether a Central Florida warehouse has it on a given day is not public. Do not confuse with 'Safe Catch Ahi Wild Yellowfin Tuna Steaks, 5 oz, 6-count' (Item 1292488): those are CANNED (6 cans). Sear and eat the day you buy it; never pack rare ahi for a shift (see food-safety.md).

supplements.rule: Plan rule (nutrition.js CERT): every supplement must carry NSF Certified for Sport or Informed Sport. 'Banned substance tested', 'third-party tested' and 'Informed Choice' do not meet it.

checked.nsf: nsfsport.com Certified Products listing, fetched 2026-11-01 (2,603 listings parsed): https://www.nsfsport.com/certified-products/search-results.php
checked.informedSport: Informed Sport certified list PDF dated October-2026 (generated 2026-10-31): https://sport.wetestyoutrust.com/sites/default/files/generated-pdf/file.pdf?v=1793419764 ; brand index https://sport.wetestyoutrust.com/certified-brands
checked.kirkland: No Kirkland Signature product appears on either list.

supplements.howToVerify: Before the first scoop of every new tub: (1) the NSF Certified for Sport or Informed Sport mark must be on the package; (2) look the product up by name, flavor and SIZE in the NSF Certified for Sport app / nsfsport.com, or on sport.wetestyoutrust.com; (3) NSF listings name specific lot numbers and package sizes, so match the lot printed on the tub. No match = don't use it.

certifiedAtCostco.item: Ascent 100% Whey, Native Whey Protein Blend, Chocolate, 4.25 lbs
certifiedAtCostco.evidence: Informed Sport list (Oct 2026) includes 'Ascent 100% Whey Protein Powder Blend'; Ascent's site states 'All products are Informed Sport Certified'. Costco's page copy (a hidden/legacy block) still says 'Informed Choice', so check the bag for the Informed Sport logo.
certifiedAtCostco.note: Costco.com shows it online (out of stock when checked, limit 5); warehouse stock not public. 25 g protein per scoop per the Costco listing.

certifiedAtCostco.item: Sports Research Creatine Monohydrate 5 grams, 240-count Veggie Capsules
certifiedAtCostco.evidence: Informed Sport list (Oct 2026) includes Sports Research 'Creatine Monohydrate Capsules'; the Costco page lists 'Informed Sport' among its claims. (NSF separately lists Sports Research Creatine Monohydrate Unflavored powder, 450 g, US.)
certifiedAtCostco.note: 4 capsules = 5 g creatine, so 240 caps = 60 days at 5 g/day. Costco: 'Item may be available in your local warehouse'; the search index dates the listing ~3 years old, so stock is uncertain.

certifiedAtCostco.item: KAGED Creatine Monohydrate + MaxCatalyst, 40 Individual Serving Stick Packs, Variety Pack
certifiedAtCostco.evidence: Informed Sport lists KAGED 'Creatine Monohydrate', 'Creatine Monohydrate + Max Absorption Technology' and 'Creatine Monohydrate Elite Series'. The Costco product name ('+ MaxCatalyst', flavored sticks) does not match any listed name exactly, and the Costco page shows no certification claim.
certifiedAtCostco.note: 20 Orange Mango + 20 Strawberry Lemonade sticks, 5 g creatine each. Use only if the box carries the Informed Sport logo and the batch checks out.

certifiedAtCostco.item: DripDrop Hydration Zero Sugar Electrolytes, 40 Individual Sticks in Resealable Pouch, Variety Pack
certifiedAtCostco.evidence: NSF lists DripDrop Zero Lemon Lime (US, 9 g) and DripDrop Zero Sugar Watermelon (US, 9 g). A DripDrop announcement (via Particl) describes the Costco 40-count as Lemon Lime + Watermelon; the Costco page returned 404 when checked, so the flavor mix is not confirmed.
certifiedAtCostco.note: Use only the Lemon Lime and Watermelon zero-sugar sticks; any other flavor in the pouch is not on the list. Don't confuse with the 33-stick 'Zero Sugar Plus' pack (Watermelon/Tangerine/Raspberry Lemonade; not checked).

certifiedAtCostco.item: Celsius Sparkling Energy Drink, Core Variety Pack, 12 fl oz, 18-count
certifiedAtCostco.evidence: Costco pack = 6 Cherry Cola, 6 Orange, 6 Kiwi Guava. NSF lists CELSIUS Sparkling Cherry Cola (US, 1 can 355 mL) plus multiple Sparkling Orange and Sparkling Kiwi Guava listings.
certifiedAtCostco.note: Optional certified pre-lift caffeine. Read the can's caffeine content against the plan's ~3 mg/kg dose and the sleep cutoff. Zero sugar, so it doesn't break the no-liquid-calories rule.

conditional.item: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein Powder, Extreme Milk Chocolate, 5.64 lbs (Item 1243880) / Vanilla Ice Cream, 5.47 lbs (Item 1243864)
conditional.why: NSF lists only GOLD STANDARD 100% WHEY DOUBLE RICH CHOCOLATE (US, 4.53 kg, specific lots) and Gold Standard 100% Whey Vanilla Ice Cream (US, 4.62 kg / 10.2 lb, specific lots). Extreme Milk Chocolate is not listed, and Costco's 5.47 lb Vanilla Ice Cream is not the listed size. Informed Sport lists only ON's 'Elite Series' products. Use only if the bag itself carries the NSF Certified for Sport mark and its lot is in the NSF app.

conditional.item: Muscle Milk Genuine Protein Shake Chocolate, 11 fl oz, 18-pack
conditional.why: NSF lists Muscle Milk Genuine Protein Shake Chocolate in the 14 fl oz bottle (US), not Costco's 11 fl oz 18-pack. The Muscle Milk 33g Ultra-Filtered shake is not on the list at all.

conditional.item: Liquid I.V. Hydration Multiplier Sugar Free, Mango Pineapple (Item 2032174) / Rainbow Sherbet (Item 1947971), 30-pack
conditional.why: NSF lists exactly one Liquid I.V. product: Hydration Multiplier Sugar Free Raspberry Lemonade (13 g stick). Costco's sugar-free flavors are not it.

conditional.item: BODYARMOR Lyte Sports Drink, Variety Pack, 20 fl oz, 18-count (Item 1779098)
conditional.why: NSF lists BODYARMOR LYTE Dragonfruit Berry and Peach Mango only for Canada, in 473 mL (16 fl oz). Costco's US pack is 20 fl oz and includes Blueberry Pomegranate (not listed). Regular BODYARMOR SuperDrink is sugar, which breaks the no-liquid-calories rule.
